general: General Performance in the last 6 months.
Gathering, evaluating, and using relevant information to understand the environment and act accordingly.
Assessing the environment in order to organize the work effectively and anticipate the consequences of one’s actions.
Questioning one’s thoughts and actions in a deliberate and pertinent manner and knowing how to manage them appropriately.
Following principles and standards of ethical behaviour and thereby helping to create and maintain a positive work environment.
Interacting effectively with others, promoting cooperation, minimising conflict and enabling people to work towards common goals.
Demonstrating voluntary and wholehearted commitment as well as the internalisation of the company’s goals for the betterment of the organisation or oneself.
Leading a team, knowing how to delegate and evaluate performance, and communicating in an inspiring manner.
Understanding and being understood by others by actively listenting to others and sharing ideas and information in an adapted manner.

groups.title: Analysis & Expertise
groups.intro: Gathering, evaluating, and using relevant information to understand the environment and act accordingly.
rows: Decision-making
Making the best possible choice based on the information available, as well as being able to explain these decisions.
Analytical Thinking
Breaking down problems and complex situations into components to find appropriate solutions.
Learning Agility
Showing an inquisitive mind with a high interest in new things.
Knowledge Management
Following the evolution of knowledge in one’s field or service in order to be up to date and gain expertise.
Perspective taking
Taking a step back to analyse facts and situations objectively before acting or deciding.
Knowledge Sharing
Transmitting one’s capabilities and expertise to others.

groups.title: Planning & Vision
groups.intro: Assessing the environment in order to organize the work effectively and anticipate the consequences of one’s actions.
rows: Time Management
Prioritising tasks pragmatically so as to meet deadlines.
Organisational Skills
Planning each action of a project by breaking it down into its parts in order to follow a systematic approach.
Strategic Planning
Establishing action plans to anticipate future developments.
Risk Management
Identifying opportunities, priorities and risks, with the aim of minimizing the probability of failure and increasing the chances of success.
Innovation and Creativity
Thinking outside the box and looking at things from new perspectives.
Global vision
Looking at the big picture to grasp things as a whole.

groups.title: Self-Management & Self-Knowledge
groups.intro: Questioning one’s thoughts and actions in a deliberate and pertinent manner and knowing how to manage them appropriately.
rows: Respecting Instructions
Adhering to procedures by following and implementing directives.
Adaptation to Change
Being able to adapt to change, adjusting one’s behaviour or attitude to an environment and people.
Persistence
Demonstrating determination and maintaining a high level of energy in the performance of duties.
Stress Management
Managing one’s own emotions and remaining calm and productive in challenging situations.
Self-appraisal
Having a critical and realistic view of one’s performance.
Responsiveness
Adjusting quickly to unexpected changes to plans and situations.

groups.title: Values & Integrity
groups.intro: Following principles and standards of ethical behaviour and thereby helping to create and maintain a positive work environment.
rows: Sense of Duty
Respecting and adherieng to codes of conduct, remaining honest, and being reliable.
Modesty
Being unassuming towards one’s own abilities and not over appreciating oneself.
Openness to Diversity
Showing tolerance and acceptance of other people’s ways of thinking, cultures, and values.
Discretion
Respecting confidentiality and exercises restraint in the disclosure of information.
Impartiality
Treating people fairly and basing decisions on objective criteria.
Respect
Behaving with regard to others’ feelings, wishes or rights.

groups.title: Relationship management
groups.intro: Interacting effectively with others, promoting cooperation, minimising conflict and enabling people to work towards common goals.
rows: Conflict Resolution
Maintaining harmony within the team by mediating conflicts.
Team Cohesion
Encouraging activities that will enable united and productive teams.
Interpersonal Skills
Interacting effectively with others, forming relationships with individuals and groups.
Sympathy
Effectively identifying and understanding the needs of another person.

groups.title: Work Commitment
groups.intro: Demonstrating voluntary and wholehearted commitment as well as the internalisation of the company’s goals for the betterment of the organisation or oneself.
rows: Quality Orientation
To be meticulous with an eye for detail to ensure the highest level of quality and service.
Initiative
Seizing opportunities and being a driving force to create or move things forward.
Taking Responsibility
Taking ownership of projects, and accepting the consequences of their success or failure.
Striving
Constantly seeking to excel and surpass one’s goals.
Involvement
Being highly committed and putting the maximum amount of energy and effort into achieving work- related objectives.
Availability
Being commited to the organization and being willing to offer help whenever possible.

groups.title: Leadership
groups.intro: Leading a team, knowing how to delegate and evaluate performance, and communicating in an inspiring manner.
rows: Team Motivation
Leading a group of people towards a common objective by winning their support and pushing them to surpass themselves.
Mentoring
Taking responsibility for employees’ development and progression by coaching them to help them improve.
Managerial Courage
Speaking confidently and setting limits when the situation demands it.
Promoting Change
Communicating a new vision in an engaging and inspirational manner to encourage involvement.
Delegation
Assigning tasks and responsibilities appropriately, according to individual abilities and needs.
Performance Management
Monitoring, managing and evaluating employees’ performance in order to maintain standards and targets.

groups.title: Communication Skills
groups.intro: Understanding and being understood by others by actively listenting to others and sharing ideas and information in an adapted manner.
rows: Influencing Skills
Promoting ideas and convincing others, as well as communicating in an assertive and tactical manner.
Strategic communication
Sharing the most relevant information, and adapting to the audiences needs and understanding.
Listening skills
Being attentive to and effectively interpreting what the other person is saying.
Self-affirmation
Making yourself heard and defending your point of view without aggressiveness, with respect for yourself and the other person.
Presentation skills
Presenting facts in a logical and understandable manner, relevant to the situation.
